summary: CivicState is MVP-code-real but remains watchlist until paid demand, coverage, delivery, and compliance prove out.
adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

thesisCurrent.label: watchlist EIR validation candidate
thesisCurrent.text: CivicState has a real civic-action workflow in the repo, but it is not near-term investible until the operator confirms business intent and market validation clears.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods.sourcePolicy: Repo and registry files are evidence; all external market claims are assumptions because network research was unavailable.

real: Monorepo with web, API, worker, and shared packages [evidence: package.json and source tree]
Submission, moderation, official lookup, payment, webhook, dashboard, admin, delivery, treasury, and Prisma schema surfaces [evidence: apps and packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma]
Hardcoded Stripe tiers of $5.00, $15.00, and $25.00 [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
notYetProven: Paid customer demand [assumption: no revenue/customer data in workspace]
Local official coverage [evidence: Cicero stub returns empty array]
Production deliverability and response rates [assumption: no production delivery metrics in workspace]

customerDefinition.primary: U.S. residents with a specific civic issue who will pay a one-time fee for researched, routed, citation-backed letters [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; assumption: willingness to pay unvalidated]
nonCustomers: Government officials as buyers [assumption: officials are recipients, not paying customers]

marketSizing.workspaceOnlyCaveat: No external market data was available; figures are assumptions.

future: Priority review [assumption: not implemented as SKU]
Organization/API plans [assumption: deferred in planning docs]

financialModel.reconciliation: orders x average order equals gross revenue; gross revenue minus variable costs equals gross profit; gross profit minus fixed cost equals contribution

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.position: Closest constituent messaging analogue [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: current product not externally verified]

competition.name: Change.org
competition.position: Petition-hosting analogue [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: current product not externally verified]

competition.name: Quorum/VoterVoice-style enterprise tools
competition.position: Organization-oriented advocacy software [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: current pricing/features not externally verified]

competition.name: Manual outreach
competition.position: Free but effort-heavy substitute [assumption: behavioral competitor]

competition.name: Generic AI writing tools
competition.position: Drafting substitutes without owned routing/payment/delivery workflow [assumption: product comparison]

holes: Demand may be fake despite civic frustration [assumption: no paid demand evidence]
Officials may ignore or suppress AI-assisted emails [assumption: no response-rate evidence]
Local official coverage is incomplete [evidence: Cicero stub]
Legal/compliance burden may exceed one-operator capacity [assumption: requires professional review]
mitigations: Run closed beta before public launch [assumption: validation method]
Gate public launch on delivery/bounce/spam metrics [evidence: delivery tracking exists]
Resolve local official provider before broad GTM [evidence: current stub]
Require legal/compliance review before public campaign SEO [assumption: risk-control method]
residualRisks: Low repeat frequency may cap LTV [assumption]
Competitors can copy workflow before data moat compounds [assumption]
Payment processors or email providers may classify civic content as elevated risk [assumption]
Citation errors or user allegations could create reputational/legal exposure [assumption]

assumptionLedger.assumption: Users will pay for a constituent letter workflow

assumptionLedger.test: Track delivered, bounced, spam complaint, and reply metrics

assumptionLedger.assumption: SEO can acquire qualified users cheaply
assumptionLedger.test: Publish compliant pages and measure qualified organic submit-starts

steps: Closed beta in one constrained geography
Paid workflow tests across all pricing tiers
External research refresh when network is available
